/.title: rsmb
/.description: Personal site and portfolio of Robby Bryson — interactive data visualizations, geospatial projects, and web tools.

/about.title: About
/about.description: Robby Bryson — software developer and geospatial engineer based in St. Louis. Background in Azure Maps, federal GIS, and startups.

/projects.title: Projects
/projects.description: Interactive projects and data visualizations by Robby Bryson — flights, route converter, and more.

/posts.title: Posts
/posts.description: Writing about projects, trips, and other things I find interesting.

/projects/adv-atlas/map.title: ADV Atlas
/projects/adv-atlas/map.description: Explore motorcycle journeys on a map, compare trip facts, and read the reports.

/projects/through-routes.title: Through Routes
/projects/through-routes.description: Find scenic, twisty motorcycle loop routes on rural roads using OpenStreetMap data.

/projects/flights.title: Flights
/projects/flights.description: An interactive 3D globe visualization of flights around the world — filter by year, see route frequencies, and explore travel statistics.

/projects/flights/map.title: Flights
/projects/flights/map.description: Interactive 3D globe visualization of flights around the world. Filter by year, see route frequencies, and explore travel statistics.

/projects/anki-artisan.title: Anki Artisan
/projects/anki-artisan.description: A CLI tool that generates Anki flashcard decks from iNaturalist observations and eBird region data.

/projects/bookend.title: Bookend
/projects/bookend.description: A personal book-tracking app to log reads, organize books into lists, and explore reading stats.

/projects/temperature-records.title: U.S. Temperature Records
/projects/temperature-records.description: Interactive map of all-time record high and low temperatures across US states and counties, powered by NOAA and ACIS data.

/projects/temperature-records/map.title: U.S. Temperature Records
/projects/temperature-records/map.description: Interactive map of all-time record high and low temperatures across US states and counties, with recent extremes summary.

/projects/temperature-records/trends.title: Standing Record Ages — U.S. Temperature Records
/projects/temperature-records/trends.description: Explore when today’s standing county temperature extremes were set, including their age distribution and geographic patterns.

/projects/tornado-tracks.title: Tornado Tracks
/projects/tornado-tracks.description: A full-screen historical tornado track map powered by NOAA/NCEI StormEvents data and MapLibre GL.

/projects/tornado-tracks/map.title: Tornado Tracks
/projects/tornado-tracks/map.description: Interactive MapLibre archive of NOAA/NCEI tornado tracks with timeline, EF-scale filters, regional presets, and density mode.

/projects/route2gpx.title: route2gpx
/projects/route2gpx.description: Convert Google Routes into GPX files for GPS devices and bike computers — a privacy-focused web app that runs entirely in your browser.

/projects/aborg.title: aborg
/projects/aborg.description: A CLI tool to scan, organize, and manage audiobook file collections into an Audiobookshelf-compatible directory structure.

/projects/parc.title: parc
/projects/parc.description: A Python CLI for building a long-running archive of podcast feeds and episodes with resumable downloads, SQLite state, and local archive audits.

/projects/status-dashboard.title: Status Dashboard
/projects/status-dashboard.description: A live terminal monitoring dashboard for AWS infrastructure, GitHub CI builds, and site health — rendered with Ink.
